messages.subject: Re: standardized variables change with meanstructure
parts:
On 12/06/2016 02:19 PM, Jarrett Byrnes wrote:
> I've had a student notice something odd. The modification Indices of a
> particular model change when meanstructure is included versus is not
> included.

That is odd indeed. My intuition is that is only due to numerical
problems (given the warning: "some observed variances are (at least) a
factor 1000 times larger than others").

Note that if you rescale (standardize), the 'problem' goes away:

richMedFit_mean <- sem(richMedMod, data = keeley, meanstructure = FALSE,
std.ov = TRUE)

richMedFit_no_mean <- sem(richMedMod, data = keeley, meanstructure =
TRUE, std.ov = TRUE)

> modificationIndices(richMedFit_mean)
lhs op rhs mi epc sepc.lv sepc.all sepc.nox
17 distance ~ rich 10.672 0.430 0.430 0.423 0.423

> modificationIndices(richMedFit_no_mean)
lhs op rhs mi epc sepc.lv sepc.all sepc.nox
21 distance ~ rich 10.672 0.430 0.430 0.423 0.423


I will try to see if the numerical issues can somehow be circumvented.

Yves.
